_comment: SEC-001 no-client-literal gate config. Literals are SALTED SHA-256 hashes (NO plaintext: a plaintext denylist would itself leak the secrets in this marketplace-bound repo, and this file is scanned). Add a literal with: check-no-client-literals.py hash "<literal>"  then run deploy.regenerate and commit. Generic tokens that collide with ordinary words/tools (e.g. a fictional 'Sun', 'Cube') must be added as an ngram with context, not a bare word, to avoid false positives. The salt is a non-secret in-tree constant (see the script's HONEST LIMITATION note). GOVERNANCE: owner = the maintainer acting as security/DPO; review the literal set at least quarterly and whenever a new client engagement OR NDA-covered partner project is named in any kit. See ADR-028 + the framework-authoring SKILL runbook. Covers client literals AND NDA-covered partner-project literals.
